LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Cinnb.]
Shooting, drawing and aching pains in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles ; < at night. θ Ischias rheumatica and syphilitica.
Lameness of thighs with coryza.
Violent itching on inside of thighs, knees and legs ; < on knees, especially at night.
Profuse, offensive sweat between thighs (when walking).
Painful twitching in leg, awakens from sleep at night.
Rheumatic pain in right knee joint ; < when walking (ascending), > at rest.
Tearing pain in legs below knees.
Coldness in joints.
Nodes on shin bones.
Pain in tendo-achillis and os calcis after walking.
Pressure and feeling of numbness in foot.
Coldness of feet, day and night.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Cinnb.]
Chilliness and lameness in arms and legs.
Wandering gout.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Cinnb.]
At rest : rheumatic pain in right knee joint >.
Lying on back : pain in forehead and top of head <.
Lying on left side : pain in forehead and top of head <.
Turning on right side : > pain in forehead and top of head.
After rising : pain in forehead and top of head >.
Stretching : > oppression and contracted feeling of chest.
Stooping : dizziness.
Walking : profuse, offensive sweat between thighs ; rheumatic pain in right knee joint <.
After walking : pain in tendo-achillis and os calcis.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cinnb.]
General nervous, uneasy sensation.
Great lassitude, prostration, and feeling of lameness in limbs.
Weariness, languor, tiredness and prostration ; < before eating, > when riding in open air.
Sensation of lameness in all the limbs.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Cinnb.]
Sleepiness in daytime and sleeplessness at night ; unconquerable desire to sleep after dinner and early in evening.
Restlessness and sleeplessness at night, from a constant flow of ideas changing from one thing to another.
Wakes suddenly after midnight with oppression of chest.
Restless sleep, with vivid dreams and much talking.
   

TIME. [38] [Cinnb.]
In morning : dizziness, after rising ; pain in forehead and top of head after waking ; soreness over exit of supraorbital nerve < ; discharge of blepharitis < ; tongue coated white ; soreness of throat ; pulse slower ; metallic taste.
In forenoon : flashes of heat in abdomen with great flatulency.
At noon : perspiration <.
After dinner : ringing in ears, with dulness and heaviness of head ; unconquerable desire to sleep ; symptoms >.
During day : secretion of tenacious mucus, inclination to empty deglutition ; soreness of throat ; sleepiness.
Early in evening : unconquerable desire to sleep.
In evening : heaviness of lids < ; increased sexual desire with violent erections ; hoarseness ; pulse accelerated.
At 8 P. M. : right molars and bicuspids feel soft, heavy and too large.
Late in evening : dulness and heaviness in head with ringing in ears.
At night : pain of left eye < ; kerato-iritis and uncomplicated iritis < ; soreness along course of supraorbital nerve and corresponding side of head < ; inflammation with dryness in mouth and throat < ; dryness and irritation of throat ; painful diarrhœa ; frequent and increased emission of watery urine ; pain in urethra wakes him up ; pains in thighs < ; violent itching on inside of thighs, knees and legs < ; painful twitching in leg awakens from sleep ; sleepless ; restlessness and sleeplessness from a constant flow of ideas ; internal and external heat of body.
After midnight : awakens suddenly with oppression of chest.
At 2 or 3 A. M. : right molars and bicuspids feel soft, heavy and too large.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Cinnb.]
In open air : weariness, languor, tiredness and prostration > when riding ; symptoms >.
In warm room : coldness and chilliness.
Heat : > dull pain in forehead, which is cold.
Worse in Summer.
   

FEVER. [40] [Cinnb.]
Coldness and chilliness in warm room.
Internal and external heat of body during whole night.
Flushes of heat confined to abdomen, with great flatulence ; < in forenoon.
Nightly fever with dry mouth.
Perspiration most at noon.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Cinnb.]
Frequent emissions of watery urine.
Intermitting : pain of kerato-iritis and uncomplicated iritis.
Coming and going gradually : sensation as if right molars and bicuspids were soft, heavy and too large.
Lasting about an hour : uneasy creeping and pressive sensation about ossa nasi.
Long continued : false labor pains.
During whole night : internal and external heat of body.
Nightly fever with dry mouth.
Periodical : shooting pains in arms.
Day and night : coldness of feet.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Cinnb.]
Right : aching in superciliary ridge of eye ; inflammation of eye ; itching, pressing and pricking at inner angle and lower lid ; shooting at canthus of eye, with burning and itching ; scurfy eruption in external ear ; itching in ear ; molars and bicuspids feel soft, heavy and too large ; second upper decayed molar feels as if it would fly to pieces on biting teeth together ; small ulcer on side of tongue ; pain in middle of upper part of arm, as if it would break ; sensation of lameness in arm ; œdema of arm ; rheumatic pain in knee joint ; itching of palm of hand ; red eruption, sometimes with pustules filled with yellow matter, under knee ; nostrils somewhat tumefied.
Left : dull pain in temple and side of head ; shooting pain in side of head ; outer half of eye injected and puffy ; severe pains seeming to run around eye ; pain in shoulder, between clavicle and scapula, interiorly ; numbness of arm, from elbow to end of little finger ; itching of side of face.
From right to left and from left to right : shooting across abdomen during pregnancy.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Cinnb.]
General nervous, uneasy sensation.
As if touched by a cold metallic body on a small space over root of nose ; as of a vise or band around head ; as of congestion in forehead ; as of putting on a heavy pair of spectacles ; as if right molars and bicuspids were soft, heavy and too large ; as if second right upper decayed molar would fly to pieces on biting teeth together ; as if upper abdomen was distended ; as of a large worm in anus ; as if a sore was in urethra when urinating ; as if chest was contracted ; as if muscles of back part of neck were contracted ; as if bruised in small of back ; as if upper part of right arm would break ; as if pimples were coming out over body ; as if crazy-bone was struck.
Pain : in forehead and top of head ; from back of head to forehead ; severe, running around left eye ; from inner canthus around eye ; in urethra on urinating ; running over ensiform cartilage from seventh rib on right side diagonally through chest to back ; in back of neck shooting to occiput ; all over back down to loins ; in left shoulder, between clavicle and scapula, interiorly ; in upper part of right arm ; in tendo-achillis and os calcis.
Cutting : in forehead.
Sudden stitches : on each side of spine, in back and lumbar region.
Stitching : above eye, from internal and external canthus, or runs around eye ; may extend into eye, or up into head.
Sticking : about punctum lachrymale of upper eyelid.
Stinging : in ears, cheeks, temples and sides of head, extending to occiput and nape of neck ; above eye, from internal to external canthus, or runs around eye ; may extend into eye or up into head.
Pricking : at inner angle and lower lid of right eye.
Shooting : in left side of head ; from occiput forward ; in forehead ; through eye into head ; at inner canthus of right eye ; across abdomen during pregnancy ; in arms ; in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles.
Tearing : in forehead ; in bowels ; on each side of spine, in back and lumbar region ; in legs below knees.
Rending : in spine.
Drawing : in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles.
Burning : in inner canthus of right eye ; around anus ; of skin.
Soreness : over exit of supraorbital nerve ; along course of supraorbital nerve and corresponding side of head ; in roof of mouth ; of throat ; in stomach.
Sharp pains : above eye, from internal to external canthus, or runs around eye ; may extend into eye or up into head.
Irritation : of throat.
Pressure : over root of nose, zygoma and temples ; in upper abdomen, after eating ; in vagina ; in foot.
Pressing : in forehead ; at inner angle and lower lid of right eye.
Pressive sensation : about ossa nasi.
Oppression : of chest.
Pinching : in urethra.
Cramps : in bowels.
Contracting pain : in throat during empty deglutition.
Tensive pains : in ears, cheeks, temples and sides of head, extending to occiput and nape of neck.
Labor-like pain : in vagina.
Rheumatic pain : in right knee joint.
Aching : in superciliary ridge of right eye, extending to back of head ; in small of back ; in thighs, from hip joints nearly down to condyles.
Tightness : in temples.
Fulness : of head ; in throat, causing constant desire for swallowing.
Heaviness : of head.
Weight : over root of nose, zygoma and temples.
Congested sensation over whole head, principally forehead.
Lightness : in head.
Dulness : of head.
Dull pain : in forehead ; in left temple and side of head.
Painful twitching : in leg.
Twitching : in penis.
Tickling : in throat.
Formication : in anus.
Creeping : about ossa nasi.
Numbness : of left arm, from elbow to end of little finger ; in foot.
Weakness : in eyes.
Lameness : of thighs ; in right arm ; in arms and legs ; in all limbs.
Uneasiness : about ossa nasi.
Painful itching : of prepuce.
Violent itching : of corona glandis ; on inside of thighs, knees and legs ; < on knees.
Itching : of eyelids, outer canthi ; ears, face (l. side), palm of right hand ; inside of thighs ; on knees, legs and shoulders ; of skin ; occasionally, in eruption under right knee ; at inner angle and lower lid of right eye ; in inner canthus of right eye ; in right ear ; of nose ; around anus.
Dryness : in mouth and throat.
Coldness : of forehead ; in joints of feet.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Cinnb.]
Syphilis ; gonorrhœa and sycotic excrescences.
Wandering gout.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Cinnb.]
Touch : bones of skull, scalp and even hair painfully sensitive to ; causes bleeding of warts on prepuce, frenum and inner surface.
Pressure : > intense headache.
Scratching : < burning and itching of skin.
On biting teeth together : second right upper decayed molar feels as if it would fly to pieces.
Riding in open air : > weariness, languor, tiredness and prostration.
   

SKIN. [46] [Cinnb.]
Itching of nose (bleeding after blowing it), of eyelids, canthi (outer), ears, face (l. side), palm of hand (right), thighs (inside), knees, legs, at anus (at night), on shoulders (evening).
Burning and itching of skin, < after scratching.
Redness of skin ; red spots on skin.
Sensation as if pimples were coming out over body.
Eruption of red points, spots and pustules.
Red, papulous eruption, without itching, on both elbows.
Red eruption on finger, sometimes with pustules filled with yellow matter ; the same under right knee, with occasional itching.
Chronic impetigo, pustules and scabs on upper lip, immediately under nose ; right nostril also somewhat tumefied.
Gangrenous ulcerations ; fiery, angry-looking ulcers. θ Sycosis.
Honeycombed ulcers ; fistulous.
Elevated ulcers, which have the appearance as if condylomata would grow out of them.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Cinnb.]
Combination of scrofula with syphilis or sycosis, or syphilis and tuberculosis.
Syphilis complicated by scrofula, or previous mercurial treatment.
Arthritic patient addicted to spirituous liquors ; prosopalgia, parotitis and vesical catarrh.
Girl, suffering from dysmenorrhœa ; tapeworm.
Man, æt. 28, sanguine temperament, scrofulous ; secondary syphilis.
Man, æt. 29, syphilitic phimosis.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Cinnb.]
Antidoted by Cinchon., Hepar, Nitr. ac., Opium, Sulphur.
Compare : Camphor (red spots) ; Laches. ; Mercur. ; Nitr. ac. and Thuya.
